title: docs(checklist, north-star): retire records-forms.picklist-org-append — the per-organization picklist append is ruled out
body:
Fixes #22869
Clause-②: no — the three paths are the North Star text and the platform-checklist ledger; no published schema, accept set or public surface is touched (no `packages/**` path).

Retires the per-organization picklist append everywhere it is still promised. The maintainer's direct order (filing gate ③ on #22869, 2026-10-11), verbatim: 「按组织追加 picklist 值，不考虑」. ADR-0131 D6 had already retired ADR-0005's per-organization overlay axis the item depended on (`docs/adr/0131-total-organization-ownership-no-null-organization-id.md`: "ADR-0005's per-organization overlay axis is retired, so `sys_metadata` needs no split (D6)"). No product code; the append is not re-scoped to environment level.

## Per file

**`docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/records-forms.json`**
- `records-forms.picklist-org-append`: `status` planned → retired, `retiredReason` added (the ruling quoted, ADR-0131 D6, "no successor", "not moved to environment level"). No `supersededBy`: nothing succeeds the capability, and neither the README nor the validator demands one. The row and every field (`personas`, `fixtures`, `negative`, `source`) stay as history, per the README's Lifecycle → Retire rule. `revision` 1 → 2 with a `history` entry, following the README's Change rule and the two retired precedents in `dashboards.json` (both bumped on retire). The validator does not decide this: its revision check is consistency-only (`revision` equals the last `history` entry). Measured both ways: unbumped gives the same 10 problems, with no revision complaint.
- `records-forms.picklist-shared-across-objects`: the `#18164` design-of-record `source` citation no longer says it "splits" the verification sentence with the retired item. Now: "…and the verification sentence, which is now this item's alone: its per-organization half left with records-forms.picklist-org-append, retired by #22869 as ruled out". The `#18164` pointer and the rest of the text are unchanged. `revision` 1 → 2 with a "source citation only" `history` entry. No clause, negative or fixture moved.

**`docs/qa/platform-checklist/coverage.json`**: the `picklist` kind's `waived` text names only `records-forms.picklist-shared-across-objects` ("the phase-2 per-organization overlay is ruled out, #22869, and no item carries it"). Its closing promise "the planned organization item beside it" is dropped. Nothing else in the waiver changed (see Acceptance notes).

**`docs/NORTH-STAR.md`**: one row (line 43), nothing else.

Before:
```text
- records · 共享选项集:多个对象复用同一份选项,客户按组织追加值而不改应用源码 · records-forms · picklist-shared-across-objects, picklist-org-append
```
After:
```text
- records · 共享选项集:多个对象复用同一份选项 · records-forms · picklist-shared-across-objects
```

No committed generated census exists: the README's "Implementation status" section says there is no `STATUS.md` in this tree and no gate paired with one. The wiki page is regenerated on a schedule by `checklist-status.yml`. A local `pnpm gen:checklist-status` (stdout only, tree left clean) now reads `records-forms 41 active / 1 planned` (it was 41 / 2), and the retired item is in neither total.

### `check:platform-checklist` — what is red, and whose it is

- **Base `117817ec2` is already red, with 8 problems.** All 8 are symbol anchors in `access-security.json`, `attachments-storage.json` and `search.json`, none in the files this PR touches. That red belongs to the watchdog (`platform-checklist-watchdog.yml`), and this gate is not per-PR CI.
- **This PR adds exactly 2**, both on the retired row: `"since" must be the release that introduced the capability` and `"steps" must be a non-empty array of strings`. The cause is in the checker, not the row. `scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs#statusFieldProblems` gives `planned` its own branch, and judges every other status (`retired` included) by the active rule. An item retired *before it was ever implemented* can satisfy that only with an invented release and invented steps. The README's Retire rule asks only for `status: "retired"` + `retiredReason`. Per the dispatch, the checker is **not** edited here, and nothing is invented to satisfy it. The fix is filed separately by the seat. ⚠️ **Landing dependency:** this PR should land after that checker fix. Landed first, it raises main's watchdog reading from 8 to 10.
- **The coverage-mapping question, measured.** The retired row with the old waiver text still naming it gives 10 problems, none of them `maps to retired item` (the 2 above plus the 8 at base). The current text gives the same 10. So a `waived` prose mention is not a mapping: the `maps to retired item` check reads only an entry's `items` array.

No changeset: no published package's `files[]` ships any of the three paths (70 non-private manifests read: 0 entries name them). The only `packages/**` mentions are two source comments citing the paths. `skip-changeset` is applied after this PR opens.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么**
「按组织追加 picklist 值」这件事,从测试清单和北极星两处撤掉。清单里那条 planned 测试项改成「已退役」。它的记录照留,只是不再算作待做。另外两处引用它的地方(同族的共享选项集测试项、覆盖率豁免说明)改成不再提它。北极星「共享选项集」那一行去掉「客户按组织追加值而不改应用源码」,只保留「多个对象复用同一份选项」。没有改任何产品代码。

**为什么改**
您 2026-10-11 的裁决:「按组织追加 picklist 值，不考虑」。ADR-0131 D6 早已取消「按组织覆盖元数据」这条轴,这条需求已没有落脚处。清单和北极星还写着,会让后来的人以为这是待做的需求。这次是直接撤掉,不是改成「按环境追加」。

**风险与代价(含回滚)**
只改文档和测试清单,不影响运行中的任何功能。一个已知代价:清单校验器目前不接受「从未实现就退役」的测试项,会多报 2 条错(主干原本已有 8 条与本 PR 无关的错)。建议先修校验器,修复单由席位另开,再合本 PR。回滚就是 revert 这个 PR,三个文件都是纯文本。

**席位意见**


**你要做的**
看一眼北极星第 43 行改后的写法是否合您的意。确认后批准(APPROVED review)或直接合并。最好等校验器修复单合入之后再合。

## Acceptance notes

- The `picklist` waiver in `coverage.json` is stale beyond what this PR touches. It still says "No runtime reads a picklist … PENDING the runtime layer (#19519)", but the runtime layer landed in `88b484e00` (#21047). `packages/spec/liveness/picklist.json` now grades `name` live (evidence `packages/objectql/src/registry.ts#resolvePicklistOptions`), and `scripts/check-stack-collection-maps.mjs` no longer carries picklist rows as PENDING. So `records-forms.picklist-shared-across-objects` may now be drivable, and promotable after a passing run. Re-authoring the waiver and the item belongs to the next coverage sweep (SWEEP.md re-audits every waiver), not to this retire. Carrier: none named.
